extraction.rank: descending geometric arclength then lexicographic first pixel; fixed 96 cap
extraction.closed_loops: Lexicographic start and forward/reverse only; no cyclic-shift search; seam mismatch is a disclosed recall limitation
extraction.duplicate_sources: Union A and admitted typed-B pixel supports before skeleton graph tracing; each geometric path has one identity and records all source bits
extraction.typed_b_nms_definition: For each raw responses B_delta_D/B_delta_A field independently, admit values >=0.65 that equal the finite maximum in the clipped 3x3 neighborhood (radius1); plateaus retain all maxima before skeletonization. Require native alpha>=0.08 for B. A>=0.5 is admitted without an additional alpha mask. No normalized_B or gray-texture substitution.

matching.path_order: monotone dynamic programming, both orientations; diagonal/horizontal/vertical steps, at most 3 repeated horizontal or vertical
matching.cost: symmetric epipolar median plus 0.25*p90; incompatible length/curvature/type excluded; best and alternative recorded before uniqueness
matching.unique_margin_ratio_definition: (second-best - best) / max(second-best,1e-12); sole finite compatible candidate has second-best=+infinity and passes margin; equal-score alternatives included
matching.orientation_definition: undirected angle modulo180 between observed 2D tangent and projection of the triangulated candidate local3D tangent in that same camera; never compare raw image angles across cameras
matching.coverage_definition: Count distinct sample indices with epipolar distance<=4px on each side, divide each count by32, take minimum; DP visitation count is not coverage
matching.cycle_definition: Compose actual point-index correspondences through3 paths, require returning reference pixel distance<=3px on at least70% distinct common reference samples
matching.camera_separation_definition: Minimum pairwise angle between calibrated world-space camera forward (+camera-Z) axes in a selected triplet, acos clipped dot product; every pair >=8deg. This is a view-separation prerequisite, not triangulation parallax.
matching.type_compatibility_definition: Nonempty intersection of source bits {A,B_delta_D,B_delta_A}; each path records the union of contributing pixel source bits.
matching.curvature_descriptor_definition: 32 equal-arclength samples give 30 interior absolute turning angles divided by pi; descriptor difference is mean absolute elementwise difference under the tested forward/reverse order.
matching.orientation_aggregation: After triangulation/refinement, median undirected projected-tangent disagreement over retained nondegenerate corresponding samples in each participating construction view <=25deg; missing/zero tangents do not supply support and are counted in coverage denominator.

triangulation.fit: actual multiview corresponding samples only; at most16 evenly arclength-selected XYZ controls; reprojection refinement only, no camera shifts, no bridges
triangulation.parallax_definition: At each corresponding sample, minimum acute ray intersection angle among all participating camera pairs >=3deg; use acos(abs(dot(unit_rays))) so parallel and antiparallel systems both fail.
triangulation.depth_sampling: Sample native fields at the observed corresponding pixel, nearest integer via floor(coord+0.5), clipped only after continuous coordinates pass image bounds; no neighborhood search to improve construction support.
triangulation.layer_weight_definition: Use native.npz topk_w = absolute transmittance*opacity contribution, never typed.npz normalized_topk_w or topk_mass. Admit finite topk_depth>near_plane with topk_id>=0 and finite topk_w>=0.05.
triangulation.layer_conflict_definition: A native sample has layer_conflict iff any two admitted topk layers have abs(z_i-z_j)>max(0.02,0.03*min(z_i,z_j)). Do not average layers or choose the layer that helps reprojection. Any retained construction correspondence with layer_conflict in any participating view rejects the whole path; retain all conflicting layer IDs/depths/weights as diagnostics.
triangulation.depth_support_definition: With no layer_conflict, candidate camera-Z z is supported if abs(z-d)<=max(0.02,0.03*z) for at least one eligible depth d: admitted native topk layer, or finite native mean depth/median_depth > near_plane when native total alpha>=0.05 (absolute alpha). Summaries are support proposals, not individual weighted layers. Nonfinite or depths <= near_plane and missing support fail; summary fallback cannot override layer_conflict.
triangulation.depth_support_denominator: For each participating construction view, count supported retained corresponding samples / all retained corresponding samples, including unsupported and low-alpha samples; every view >=0.7, zero denominator fails. Conflicted samples may not be dropped to rescue a path.
triangulation.construction_coverage_definition: For each participating construction path, distinct original 32 sample indices retained with finite nondegenerate correspondence, orientation and reprojection support /32 >=0.7. No denominator shrinking after failed samples.

visibility.uncertain_policy: render visible with uncertainty count; never suppress by 2D proximity
visibility.outside_policy: separate out_of_frame label; never count as successful occlusion
visibility.field_sampling: Nearest native pixel floor(coord+0.5), clipped only for coordinates already continuously in-frame. No image-edge or path-neighbor query is permitted in visibility classification.
visibility.reliability_definition: At the projected pixel: finite alpha>=0.8; finite mean depth d>near_plane and median m>near_plane; variance=max(moment2/alpha-d*d,0); variance/(d*d)<=0.0004; abs(m-d)/d<=0.03; no native layer_conflict. Otherwise uncertain. A reliable sample is occluded iff candidate camera-Z z>m+max(0.02,0.03*z); all other positive-depth in-frame samples remain predicted-visible.

validation_rules.unjustified_absence: Audit every O sample using the A_absence definition. Such evidence never changes O, V, visibility, geometry or the rendering mask; it only contributes whole-path rejection diagnostics.
validation_rules.denominator: For each view independently: I=all 64 arclength samples with finite projection, camera-Z>0.001 and 0<=x<800,0<=y<800; O=depth-only reliably occluded subset; V=I\O, including low-alpha and uncertain. Never remove an element using 2D evidence.
validation_rules.noneligible_views: All4 views run contradiction and unjustified-absence gates, including ineligible views. Any applicable gate failure rejects whole path. Separately require >=2 eligible views and all eligible views pass support/depth/uncertainty gates. Empty I, empty V or empty O never supplies a positive validation vote.

sample_sets.O: reliably occluded samples using only frozen native-depth visibility
sample_sets.V: I minus O; all geometrically predicted-visible samples
sample_sets.U: V samples with unreliable native visibility evidence
sample_sets.J: V samples with position<=3px AND undirected direction<=25deg to the same uncapped validation A/typed-B skeleton evidence
sample_sets.D: V samples with nonconflicting native depth support at the projected pixel using the construction support rule
sample_sets.A_absence: O samples having same-tangent admitted line evidence within3px whose native depth at that evidence pixel supports candidate camera-Z and has no layer_conflict
sample_sets.K: Union of V samples lacking J, all I samples with layer_conflict, all I samples with reliable depth disagreement abs(z-m)>max(0.02,0.03*z) except justified O, and A_absence; count each sample once

position_direction_support.zero_denominator: null; cannot satisfy eligibility or support gate

depth_support.zero_denominator: null; cannot satisfy eligibility or support gate

uncertain.zero_denominator: null; not tested; view is ineligible

unjustified_absence.zero_denominator: null, not applicable; numerator must be0 and gate is nonfailing, never an eligible-view success
unjustified_absence.gate: <=0.1 in each of all4 validation views with |O|>0

contradiction.zero_denominator: null, not applicable; numerator must be0 and gate is nonfailing, never an eligible-view success
contradiction.gate: <=0.2 in each of all4 validation views with |I|>0

validation_rules.eligibility_definition: Geometric only: |V|>=16; sum Euclidean projected lengths of consecutive original 64 sample pairs whose two endpoints are in V >=20px (do not connect across occluded/out-of-frame gaps); maximum pairwise distance among V projected points >=12px. No 2D evidence enters eligibility.
validation_rules.line_evidence_definition: Use full uncapped union of frozen A and admitted typed-B support with the same skeletonization; no construction 96-path cap or 24px minimum in validation. An evidence tangent is the vector between its two ordered neighbors on an unbranched skeleton path; endpoints use their incident segment. Junctions with no unique tangent and zero tangents cannot support J or A_absence. Find any same-tangent evidence within3px; this query is diagnostic only and cannot hide samples.
validation_rules.nonfinite_policy: Nonfinite asset or projection arithmetic rejects path as invalid_geometry, not out_of_frame. Finite camera-Z<=near_plane and finite outside-frame projections have separate labels and do not count as successful occlusion.

render.width_source: constant display brush; no world thickness claim
render.residual: complete frozen original C; no duplicate subtraction
render.edit_demo: first accepted persistentID: width2->4 and blue->magenta; XYZ byte hash unchanged, same edit in first/mid/last arc

null.pass_condition: no accepted credible fixed paths; any surviving geometry is disclosed and invalidates scientific GO
null.operation: Freeze candidate pair association slots, seed1730 derange complete target-path records among target identities (no fixed points when at least2); do not rematch. Recompute same compatibility, uniqueness, triangulation and validation gates on forced wrong associations. With fewer than2 eligible target identities report null insufficient, not passed.
